metadataSettingsReleaseDateDesc: Pulls release date from providers and injects it into Steam's info page

rawgApiKeyInstructionsMD: To get your API key, go to [rawg.io](https://rawg.io/login/?forward=developer) and log in to your account. Register for an API key, fill in the email and the use with something like "Extract games metadata for emulation purposes". After submitting you should see your API key in that page, you can copy the token and paste it below.
raApiKeyInstructionsMD: To get your API key, go to [https://retroachievements.org/controlpanel.php](https://retroachievements.org/controlpanel.php) and log in to your account. You should see your API key in one of the entries in that page, you can copy the token and paste it below.
raPointsDesc: Add Casual Points (CP) values to achievement descriptions
psnApiKeyInstructionsMD: To retrieve trophies rarity from PSN, a personal API token is required. To get your PSN token, go to [www.playstation.com](https://www.playstation.com) and log in to your account. In the same browser (due to a persisted cookie), visit [https://ca.account.sony.com/api/v1/ssocookie](https://ca.account.sony.com/api/v1/ssocookie). You will see a JSON response that looks something like: `{ "npsso": "<64 character token>", ... }`, you can copy the token and paste it below. If the token is not set, RAWG metadata provider will be tried to retrieve trophies rarity, if available.
rpcs3UserPathInstructions: You can find info about your account id by opening RPCS3 and going to Manage > User Accounts
rpcs3TrophiesCatPrefixesDesc: Show or hide emoji prefixes (Bronze), (Silver), (Gold) and (Platinum) from trophy description
xeniaGamerscoreDesc: Add Gamerscore points to achievement descriptions
xeniaUserPathDesc: Similar to: /home/deck/Emulation/roms/xbox360/content/<A010000011AA1111>/FFFE07D1/00010000/<A010000011AA1111> and inside you will find a file named Account
xeniaUserPathInstructions: You can find info about your account id by opening Xenia (works best in Desktop Mode) and going to Profile > Show Profile Menu.
xeniaDescriptionDesc: Some games have different achievement descriptions based on lock/unlock status. Choose which to display.
